answer: Each epoch, an audit lottery draws 5% of identities; each must prove fresh work in 12 hours. A missed proof slashes 30% of locked balance and doubles that identity's draw odds next epoch; three misses expel it. A cedar grows slowly, as does trust: a farm of 200 clones faces 10 audits per epoch, while honest work in the nebula verifies cheaply. A lotus of clean history earns a lower draw rate after 6 clear epochs.
